name: hoian-audio-guide
description: Hội An Audio Guide – hệ thống thuyết minh đa ngôn ngữ rảnh tay cho Phố cổ Hội An

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w services/gateway -w services/auth -w services/location -w services/content -w services/analytics -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w packages/shared && vitest run --config tests/integration/vitest.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && node scripts/dev.mjs
